import importlib.util, json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/work/tmp/dev')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fz", "/work/tmp/dev/fuzz.py")
fz = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(fz)
tot_alloc=0; maxev=0
for i in range(20):
    rng=random.Random(2000+i)
    doc=fz.gen(rng)
    r=fz.main.run(json.loads(json.dumps(doc)))
    m=r['metrics']
    tot_alloc+=m['allocations']
    print(i, "n=",doc['n'],"e=",len(doc['edges']),"r=",len(doc['rounds']),
          "alloc=",m['allocations'],"ping=",m['network_ping_tx'],"ack=",m['network_ack_tx'],
          "late=",m['late_ping'],"ign=",m['ignored_ack'],"dedup=",m['deduplicated_ping'],
          "cap=",m['capacity_drops'],"paths=",r['summary']['topology_paths'],"cls=",r['summary']['observable_classes'],
          "obs=",r['summary']['observed_classes'], r['summary']['coverage_status'], "end=",m['end_us'])
EOF
